skill.summary: Fetch real-time AI news briefings from the AI News Oracle API (Hacker News, TechCrunch, The Verge). Uses a10m.work registry for discovery and Paymaster for gasless transactions.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of ai-news-oracle skill.
- Fetch real-time AI news briefings from Hacker News, TechCrunch, and The Verge.
- Summaries generated by a local Qwen-2.5-Coder model for accuracy and consistency.
- Integrated gasless transactions via Base Paymaster (supports USDC).
- Discoverable through the a10m.work decentralized registry.
- Free tier available; premium tier supports unlimited API calls via USDC micropayments.
